correctness.rationale: Fresh arithmetic recomputation verified that the ten least primes congruent to 7 mod 9 above 2000 are 2113,2131,2203,2221,2239,2293,2311,2347,2383,2437 (next 2473), and independently recomputed 3^((l-1)/3) mod l as 438,1,1,1,295,1303,1428,1284,1,2351. Das-Jha Theorem A states that if 3l is a cube sum then h3(12l)=2, while Lemma 2.5 gives h3=2 iff the cubic residue symbol is 1 in this family, so the six non-1 residues validly imply non-cube-sum.
